features.quote: beneath the Byzantine building ... a stepped water pool

date.basis: below the Byzantine monastery; report says the earlier layer's date cannot yet be determined (type said to be common in late Second Temple remains)

notes: One-paragraph report, no plan. The site map ref given (1400/1905) is the unit's own point. The stepped pool lies beneath the Byzantine building at the site, with no direction given, so its position is none. The pool is not dated: the report links its type to the late Second Temple period but says the earlier layer cannot yet be dated, so the code is U. The moat at the western end of the site is not a pool, pit or grave and is not coded. Graves and tombs are not mentioned, which is silence, not an absence statement. The Hasmonean palace (1 km W) and Cypros (800 m N) are named only as landmarks; nothing about their installations is said.
